Frequently Asked Questions

Do you stock BCI Group 31 batteries?

BCI-standard batteries are produced on request. Our core stocked lines are JIS and DIN standards; BCI Group 31/8D are made-to-order.

What is the MOQ for BCI batteries?

Standard MOQ is 1 × 20ft container, with flexibility for trial orders. Contact us for current terms.
